scientific_integrity: The rational matrix follows from a primitive-substitution frequency recurrence; a standalone exact checker reproduces all 32 entries and a separate prefix test confirms normalization. No independent review has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only consecutive run lengths and their limiting joint law are treated; no Markov property, arbitrary-lag law, or convergence rate is asserted. Earlier unindexed equivalent formulas are a historical-priority risk.
title: Exact successive-run law for the Rudin–Shapiro word
